name: jev-hooks
description: Nine Claude Code hooks backed by TypeSafe's Jev (System One): a Bash risk gate, a model router for subagents, compaction triage that preserves decisions, verification of subagent reports, a Stop self-check, loop detection, a prompt-kind hint, a gate on file writes git cannot undo and a gate that narrows bulky tool output before it enters context. Your own TYPESAFE_API_KEY; every hook fails open.
